name: the-block
description: Buyer-side vehicle auction prototype — Angular + NestJS + SQLite

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @the-block/api" "npm run dev -w @the-block/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @the-block/web && npm run build -w @the-block/api
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @the-block/api
